title: Water Bottles
statement:
You start with `numBottles` bottles, all full of water. Drinking a full bottle leaves you an empty one, and a shop will trade you one full bottle for any `numExchange` empty bottles you hand in (you may trade as often as you have enough empties).

Return the largest total number of bottles you can drink.
notes:
## Intuition

Play the process in rounds. In each round you drink every full bottle you hold, which adds that many empties; then you trade as many groups of `numExchange` empties as you can, and the leftovers carry over to the next round. The rounds stop when a trade yields no new full bottle. Each round cuts the bottle count by a factor of about `numExchange`, so only a few rounds happen. (A closed form, `numBottles + floor((numBottles - 1) / (numExchange - 1))`, gives the same total.)

## Approach

1. Set `drunk = 0`, `full = numBottles`, `empty = 0`.
2. While `full > 0`: add `full` to `drunk` and to `empty`.
3. Trade: `full` becomes `floor(empty / numExchange)` and `empty` keeps the remainder `empty % numExchange`.
4. When no full bottles are left, return `drunk`.

## Example 1, step by step

`numBottles = 9`, `numExchange = 3`.

| Round | `full` drunk | `drunk` | `empty` before trade | `full` after trade | `empty` left |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 9 | 9 | 9 | 3 | 0 |
| 2 | 3 | 12 | 3 | 1 | 0 |
| 3 | 1 | 13 | 1 | 0 | 1 |

`full` is 0, so the answer is `13`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(log numBottles) rounds, since each round divides the bottles by at least `numExchange` (at least 2) apart from a small remainder.
- Space: O(1).

## Pitfalls

- Keep the leftover empties (`empty % numExchange`); dropping them undercounts, as in Example 2 where a leftover bottle joins the next trade.
- Bottles obtained by trading become empties after drinking too and can be traded again.
- Use integer division (`Math.floor`), not plain `/`.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `drunk` | bottles drunk so far (the answer) |
| `full` | full bottles in hand at the start of a round |
| `empty` | empty bottles not yet traded |

narration.3: All the starting bottles are full.
narration.6: Keep going while there is something to drink.
narration.7: Drink every full bottle in hand.
narration.8: Each one becomes an empty bottle.
narration.9: Trade empties in groups of numExchange for new full bottles.
narration.10: Empties that do not make a full group wait for the next round.
narration.13: No full bottles are left and no trade is possible, so this is the total.
